issuer: the transport officers of the Department of Transport

licence.name: Belize Driving Licence (motor vehicles other than motor cycles, public service and goods vehicles)

note: Read 2026-10-31 in the Motor Vehicles and Road Traffic Act, Cap. 230, Revised Edition 2020 (the substantive law as at 31 December 2020, with Acts 8 of 2008 and 22 of 2018), as the Attorney General's Ministry publishes it. Applications for driving licences are made to the transport officer (s. 33), an officer of the Department of Transport, in which the administration of the Act is vested (s. 3); s. 34 puts private cars in class (d); s. 36: except for goods and public service vehicles (18, s. 35), any person not under seventeen and not otherwise disqualified is eligible for a learner's licence or a driving licence. The fee is 'such fee as may from time to time be prescribed' (s. 39) and a licence runs from the holder's birth-date in the year of issue until the birth-date in a subsequent year (s. 42), the years set by regulation; the regulations (and the councils' fee tables) weren't read, so the fee and the years are null. No amending Act after the 2020 revision was looked for. The city and town councils' traffic departments, which the register's entry named, weren't read; the issuer is named as the Act names it.

sources.title: Motor Vehicles and Road Traffic Act, Chapter 230, Revised Edition 2020, Attorney General's Ministry of Belize
sources.said: MOTOR VEHICLES AND ROAD TRAFFIC ACT ... SHOWING THE SUBSTANTIVE LAWS AS AT ... 31ST DECEMBER, 2020 ... Applications for driving licences shall be made to the ... transport officer on such form as may from time to time be ... under the age of seventeen years and not being otherwise ... disqualified shall be eligible to obtain a learner’s licence or a ... driving licence. ... shall be issued or renewed to be and remain valid from the ... holder’s birth-date in the year of the issue or renewal until his ... birth-date in a subsequent year. ... “Department” means the Department of Transport established
